source_format: 53-field JSON player-game arrays in all11 downloaded/reused historical files
excluded: All other game/annual fields, all current impact/possession ratings, annual actual NBA pick index45, player minutes, age/class and all2019+sources. No labels or NBA identity lookup.
group_identity: Exact(source_season,source_player_id,source_team), with exact trimmed player name consistency. No fuzzy alias resolution.
source_consistency_requirements: Supported53-field schema and exact source season; dates July1 prior year throughMay31 current source season.
Finite nonnegative integer counts, makes<=attempts, points=2*two_m+3*three_m+ft_m, personal fouls<=5.
Unique semantic(player,team,date,opponent) and source(player,team,game-id) keys; ambiguous same-day multiple opponents/teams quarantine whole group.
Exactly one same-year annual row matching source player id/team and exact trimmed name; GP and all6 shooting counts equal summed game records.
Any malformed game attributable to a group quarantines that entire group. Unassignable malformed rows would quarantine the whole season; none occurred.

Any malformed annual row with recoverable identity quarantines that group, including invalid duplicates beside a valid row; unassignable malformed annual rows block the season. No malformed annual rows occurred in this run.
metric_units: cgd_observed_gp is an integer count of that player’s included source game records. Each other field is the sum of direct events over those same records divided by observedGP, with no team-game denominator.
missingness: Quarantined groups retain all15 numeric cells missing. Source all-zero records are retained as observed records, not guessed DNPs. Missing games or annual rows are not assigned zero.
DNP_semantics: The source can contain all-zero basic stat lines; minutes and explicit participation flags are outside the approved projection. Counts follow source record inclusion only when its appearance count matches annualGP. This does not independently prove DNP/minutes semantics.
projection_status: Every validly parsed source game is preserved, even if its player-season is quarantined. Consumers must use the group audit gate. Rejected rows retain exact source row/hash/reason provenance with raw response private.
current_subset_definition: Consistent source-selected games; 2018 pilot demonstrated exclusion of Midway/Boyce. Do not assert a uniform all-games or D1-only universe for every year without schedule-specific proof.
